# network.read_gpkg { #cflowdist.network.read_gpkg }

```python
network.read_gpkg(file)
```

Read a GeoPackage file and return a dictionary of GeoDataFrames.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                      | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------|------------|
| file   | str    | The path to the GeoPackage file. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                        |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | A dictionary where the keys are the layer names and the values are the corresponding GeoDataFrames |
